subject: 明代北方大民居，10×8格，五开间灰砖硬山住宅（原创扩展；细部待考）
prompt: Use case: sketch-to-render. This block is the PRECISE body proportions of a10-by8-metre ordinary northern Ming Chinese house. Keep all footprint edges, corners and wall plane positions IDENTICAL to reference; simply texture walls as fine aged grey brick, add a grey clay-tile hard-gable pitched roof above this volume, a plain wood double door with lattice windows on the light left-front facade. Five bays on frontage. Roof ridge parallel to left-front edge; gable side flush grey masonry, roof no upward-curled ends. Do not change width/depth proportions or camera. This base's bottom edges are exact +0.5 and-0.5 slopes and must remain EXACT. Left(200,610),front(800,910),right(1280,670),back(680,370) in1536x1024 canvas. Five-bay front should not cause widening: narrow the bays to fit exact body. Side facade is deep, close to width of frontage. Thin stone apron all around, complete visible corners. Detailed realistic historical painted game asset, muted colors, upper-left light, clean cutout. Only one single-storey residence, no yard/fence/people/text/labels. Genuine transparent RGBA exterior, opaque architecture, no halo/glow. No thick foundation, no surrounding scenery, no perspective vanishing point. Maintain guide's entire base silhouette.

references.role: 精确几何导引，仅作image_gen输入；最终图未经仿射纠偏

created_time_basis: 本轮所选候选接收后登记时间
footprint_basis: 【建议值】design/22 §3.3 宋院落10×8同级尺寸；明民居骨架仅给7×6，较大版本沿用用户明确大小两种
visual_review: 原目标、几何导引及所选原图均逐张view_image；灰砖硬山、灰瓦木窗、左上光、完整轮廓与透明留边。基脚实测+0.51674/-0.50759；比例1.26707，目标1.25000。
source_point_semantics: 逐图视检定位基脚左右外缘x，alpha>200下缘取x251..699/951..1249线性拟合；F为两可见直边交点；不含透明阴影。
candidate_count_basis: 仅本轮 revision=2；前轮次数见 revision_history
selection_reason: 在本轮2候选中选择双轴和宽深整体残差较低者；残差如实保留。
final_visual_review: 已逐张view_image成品；屋檐、薄基脚完整，透明留边与灰砖灰瓦细节可读；未修改投影，仅裁切等比缩放补透明边。残差见meta。
